calculation.description: Ranks 20-session momentum scaled by 60-session daily volatility and confirmed by the sign of 60-session momentum. A past-only VIX z-score attenuates stressed-regime signals and modestly amplifies calm-regime signals. VIX is aligned and forward-filled only from observed dates; signal is lagged by the completed daily bar in online use.

validation.regime_notes: Early third IC 0.01236 (ICIR 1.13), middle third IC -0.02017 (ICIR -1.81), recent third IC 0.06237 (ICIR 5.73), recent 120 observations IC 0.05133 (ICIR 1.63). Strong recent regime dependence; small cross-section implies conservative uncertainty interpretation.
